_help: Games of the Week (games-of-the-week.html): each school week has 3 games for Grades 1–3 (g13) and 3 different games for Grades 4–6 (g46), picked from games already on the site to fit the month's unit. Keyed by month, then by in-month week (1, 2, ...) using the start-month rule in school-year.js (a week belongs to the month its Monday is in). Each pick is [game name, one-line reason]. Names must match a New Games, Warm Up Games or Big-Group Games card exactly; the build warns if one does not, if a game repeats inside a month within a grade band, or if both bands share a game the same week. Equipment and the link come from the game's card. Edit, then run: node tools/build.js

g13: Say My Name Rock, Paper, Scissors
A quick way to learn everyone’s name in the first week.
Here, There, Everywhere
Teaches the stop and travel signals you will use all year.
Kangaroos and Crocodiles
Listen for your team name, then race home: a first-week listening game.
g46: Everyone can tag, so the whole class is moving from the first minute.
Short passes along a row teach first touch and passing lanes.
Three balls at once mean more touches and quick decisions.

g13: Sharks and Dolphins
A tag warm-up with rescues, so nobody sits out.
Traffic Lights (kick)
Dribble, trap and stop on a colour: ball control at their own speed.
Through the Gates
Partner passing and trapping, the first soccer skill of the unit.
g46: Short bursts of chasing for a quick, fair warm-up.
Dribble or pass past defenders who win the ball, not the body.
Four nets keep a big class busy with lots of touches.

g13: Circle Racing
Steady running with a partner to get ready for the Terry Fox run.
Rob the Nest (dribble)
Everyone dribbles at once to bring a ball home.
Avoid the Mines
Everyone dribbles at once with their head up.
g46: Builds steady running for the Terry Fox run on Friday.
Teams work together to win balls and carry them home.
Every pin is a goal, so passing and shooting pay off fast.

g13: Old Grey Cat
A simple chase game with one clear signal to run.
Dash and Dribble
A dribbling relay with a trap at the cone.
End Zone Ball
Roll the ball to a teammate in the end zone: an easy first team game.
g46: Dodging past defenders, like a ball carrier finding space.
A low-key first football game that builds core strength.
Small-group keep-away for quick passes and getting open.

g13: Knock ’em Downers
Two jobs and nonstop movement: knock down or stand up.
Land and Sea
Jump to land or sea on the call for body control and listening.
Octopus
Cross the gym past the octopus; tagged players become helpers.
g46: The blob grows, so players must plan their escape routes.
Small touches through cones to sharpen close control.
Steal the flags and bring them home: attack and defend at once.

g13: Jellyfish
A gentle tag game where tagged players become jellyfish helpers.
Catch the Ice Cream
Toss a beanbag into a partner’s cone: soft hands for catching.
Captain Ball
Pass to a captain in a hoop: a first passing game with a target.
g46: Fast chasing and dodging to start football class.
Teams complete passes before scoring, so everyone touches the ball.
A busy whole-class game with foam footballs.

g13: Fishbowl Tag
An easy tag game with a safe fishbowl to rest in.
Hoop Rollers
Roll a ball through a rolling hoop for aim and timing.
Collect the Treasure
Carry treasure home one piece at a time as a team.
g46: Running through zones past a tagger, like finding a gap.
Pass a foam football with no running, then shoot at the basket.

g13: Tic Tac Run
A relay with a quick thinking game at the end.
Catch & Step
Partner throwing and catching that gets harder as you succeed.
Steal the Bacon
Listen for your number and race for the object.
g46: Dodge and change direction past hidden taggers.
Practise the drop-kick, the last football skill of the unit.
Pass only, and score with a clean catch in the end zone.

g13: Tail Tag
Pull a tail, then hand it back so the game keeps going.
Target Toys
Throw at fun targets for underhand and overhand aim.
Crab Football
Push the ball with a crab walk: big fun and core strength.
g46: Read the taggers and pick the safest corner.
Two balls in play make players watch and pass quickly.
Pass and move into space, the same idea as football.

g13: Storm Chasers
Simple calls and lots of moving to warm up for hockey.
Hockey Dribbling Shapes
Everyone stick-handles at once, from simple to tricky.
Numbers Hockey
Short, safe floor hockey games with sticks kept low.
g46: A new tag game where nobody knows who the taggers are.
Dribble through gates and under hurdles for points.
A small-sided game that uses the hockey ideas of attack and defence.

g13: Frozen Tag
A friendly freeze tag: a teammate frees you, so nobody sits out.
Hockey hurdle dribble
Tiny touches with the blade on the floor through low cones.
Air Hockey (cone puck)
Push a cone puck with the stick to score: easy stick control.
g46: Tag where a throw and catch frees frozen players.
Dribble around cones, then shoot at a target.
Teams aim at one big target ball, never at people.

g13: Shadow Tag
Tag a shadow, not a body: safe chasing with sticks put away.
Fishing
Hook cones with a noodle and bring them home: stick-style control.
Bottle Flip Hockey
Shoot at bottles to flip and knock them: aim with the stick.
g46: Everyone can tag, so the whole class is moving from the first minute.
One controlled shot after a dribble to knock a pin.
Each hit moves the target farther away: passing accuracy.

g13: Turtle Tag
Flip onto your back like a turtle to be safe: silly and simple.
Skittle Ball
Underhand rolls at pins for aim, a lead-up to passing.
Bean Bag Battle
A team tossing battle to finish the hockey unit.
g46: Secret taggers keep everyone alert and scanning.
Four teams aim at pins and defend their own.
Knock the noodle off the house; defenders intercept like hockey.

g13: Alien Tag
A noodle tag warm-up with a quick jumping-jack return.
Follow the Leader
Copy the leader’s move or shape; take turns leading.
Eagles vs Seahawks
A big team game of chasing and collecting.
g46: Short bursts of chasing for a quick, fair warm-up.
Build a hut together, then knock it down with a soft ball.
Lob soft balls over the net to find the hidden ships.

g13: Frog Tag
Leapfrog rescues keep everybody moving.
Silly Bananas
Move like the called fruit or animal, then freeze.
Ice Floe Crossing
Cross the icy water stepping only in hoops, together.
g46: Runners cross the middle and tagged players help the wolves.
Partner throwing at cones: hit one and it becomes yours.
Throw to knock targets while teammates reload: aim and teamwork.

g13: Waspital
Everybody-is-it tag with a stretch hospital to start the term.
Dice Wave Dribble
A roll of the die sends groups dribbling across the gym.
Collect the Treasure
Carry treasure home one piece at a time as a team.
g46: Pass the ball to get close enough to tag.
Chest passes off the wall in a quick relay.
Score while noodle taggers send you back.

g13: Tail Tag
Pull a tail, then hand it back so the game keeps going.
Dribble the gates
Dribble through cone gates with finger pads and head up.
Captain Ball
Pass to your captain: the first basketball team game.
g46: A tagged ball carrier must pass, so passing beats dribbling.
Pass, then move, so the next pass happens on the run.
Pass to a teammate in a corner hoop to score: getting open.

g13: Fruit Salad
Switch corners on your fruit: quick feet and listening.
Bounce & Scoop
Catch a one-bounce feed: tracking the ball.
Rob the Nest
Dribble to collect objects, one per trip.
g46: Steal from the middle and decide when to go.
One pass before a shot, in small teams.
Catch a pass on the bench to bring a teammate up.

g13: Octopus
Cross the gym past the octopus; tagged players become helpers.
Side to Side
Partner passing with side jumps between hoops.
Hoop Target Bowling
Land a throw in a hoop: aim like a basketball shot.
g46: Everyone can tag, so the whole class is moving from the first minute.
Catch the dropped ball: quick hands for passing.
Jump, pass and shoot in a fast team game.

g13: Slippery Snakes
Jump or step over a wiggling rope: a gentle start to ropes.
Frogs on the Lily Pads
Two-foot jumps from hoop to hoop with a sticky landing.
Musical Hoops
Travel to the music, then share a hoop. Nobody sits out.
g46: Leave your base on the call and claim a new one.
Spin a hoop, do jumping jacks, catch it, and add one.
Partners use skipping ropes to carry a hoop home.

g13: Icebergs
Hoop islands that shrink, so everyone shares a spot.
Hop-the-hoops relay
Hop through the hoops on one foot with planned landings.
Hungry Snake
Teams stay linked as a snake and pass objects back to the tail.
g46: Short bursts of chasing for a quick, fair warm-up.
Jump the sliding noodle and stick the landing.
Musical hoops with a twist: balance and body control.

g13: Rush Hour
A traffic game for speed changes and safe spacing.
Knee-ball jumps
Jump with a ball between your knees: control while jumping.
Jump to Hoop Race
A jumping relay from hoop to hoop.
g46: Drop the waist hoop and do 5 jumping jacks to rejoin.
Beat the team mark from the same line.
Change the jump or step on each 8-count phrase.

g13: Mirror Mirror
Run to music, then freeze and copy a partner’s pose.
Jump The River
Jump the gap between two ropes, and it widens after each success.
Pony Roundup
Gallop and skip away from the herders.
g46: Three teammates work together to guard one player.
Hop and jump hoop to hoop with the agreed action.
One strong minute of jumping, then a short rest.

g13: Beach Ball or Scarf Keep-Up
Keep one beach ball or scarf up as a team: the first step to volleying.
Catch Clap
Clap once, then catch: eyes on the ball.
Back to Base
Travel, then hurry home on the whistle.
g46: Bump in a circle and beat the number on your card.
A relay to set or volley balls into your team hoop.
Volleyball meets four square with a waist-high net.

g13: Catch the Ice Cream
Toss a beanbag into a partner’s cone: tracking and a soft catch, a lead-up to volleying.
Bounce & Scoop
Catch a one-bounce feed: tracking the ball.
Tidy the Bedroom
Underhand throws into hoops, a lead-up to the underhand serve.
g46: Quick hands and ready position for volleyball.
Keep a rally going against the wall with one bounce.
Small-sided volleyball over a rope net.

g13: Throw-clap-catch relay
Toss, clap and catch: eyes on the ball after a send.
Racquet waiter
Balance, then a short toss: soft hands for setting.
Protect the Castle
Send at a target while defenders block.
g46: Throw after a sit-up: core strength and an accurate send.
Open-hand rallies over a line or bench.
Throw and catch over the net, a stepping stone to volleyball.

g13: Sharks and Dolphins
A tag warm-up with rescues, so nobody sits out.
Catch & Step
Partner throwing and catching that gets harder as you succeed.
Bozo / bucket toss
Underhand tosses into buckets at longer distances.
g46: Everyone can tag, so the whole class is moving from the first minute.
Bounce the ball into the other team’s space: aim and placement.
Hoop courts and paddles for striking and rallies.

g13: Animals
Animal moves warm up arms, legs and core for gymnastics.
Frogs on the Lily Pads
Two-foot jumps with a stuck landing.
Safe to Shore
Cross the floor using only the islands: balance and planning.
g46: Hear the word, do the shape or travel.
Walk the bench and move cones from side to side.
Co-operative challenges on mats, done as a team.

g13: Daytime / Nighttime
Travel, then freeze in a strong, still shape.
Floor rope walk
Walk a floor line with airplane arms, then hold a balance.
Slip and Slide (mat relay)
Slide and travel on mats in a short relay.
g46: The whole class builds a three-part challenge together.
Jump the targets with quiet, stuck landings.
A stuck landing claims the hoop. Three in a row wins.

g13: Numbers (body shapes)
Travel, then freeze in a number shape.
Beanbag head walk
Still head and airplane arms with a beanbag on top.
Turtle Race
Crawl with a cone on your back: slow and steady control.
g46: Make bridges and tunnels, then travel through them.
Walk the hands out and back: core and shoulder strength.
Link a crawl into a roll across the mats.

g13: Bridges & Rivers
Half the class makes shapes while the others travel over and under.
Crab Tag
Everyone moves in crab walk: strong arms for gymnastics.
Follow the Leader
Copy the leader’s move or shape; take turns leading.
g46: Three moves without stopping for strength and control.
Jump and land so the rolling ball ends up between your feet.
Partner strength walks to bronze, silver and gold cones.

g13: Sneak & React
Quick starts, like the start of a sprint.
Jungle Run Relays
A relay with a hoop, a jump and a cone.
Plant the Trees
Two jobs and nonstop movement: plant or knock down.
g46: Short sprints with a head start: speed practice.
Beat the team mark from the same line.
Run a lap and tag the next runner fairly.

g13: Survivor Tag
Tagged players do a skill, then get right back in.
Shuttles (cone ball)
A shuttle relay to sharpen starts and turns.
Colour Hunt
Run and collect the colour that is called.
g46: Run on the call in a circle: quick reactions.
Timed two-foot jumps over a rolling ball.
Sprint, do a skill at the cone, sprint back.

g13: Dash for Safety
Run to the called colour before the taggers reach you.
Hop-the-hoops relay
One-foot hops with a planned landing.
Balance Carry
Carry an object without dropping it: control while moving.
g46: Grab-and-go sprints for Track and Field Day week.
Learn to pace a run so you reach the cone on time.
Carry a beanbag through traffic: speed and dodging.

g13: Rubber Band
Travel away, then sprint back to the circle on the signal.
Zig-zag touch relay
Change direction at each cone and tag the next runner.
Fetch Relay
One item per trip, then tag the next runner.
g46: Sprint to the right zone on the call: reaction starts.
Remember the order, then sprint the cones.
Read a map with a partner and run to each control.

g13: Kangaroos and Crocodiles
Listen for your team name, then race home.
Jump The River
Jump across, and the river gets wider each round.
Rescue Relay
Run across and bring a teammate home.
g46: Short bursts of chasing for a quick, fair warm-up.
Run the triangle, then throw to knock the pin.
Three quick relays to finish the track unit.

g13: Tidy Up
Chase a moving bucket to return balls: quick feet.
Overarm throw-and-catch
Practise the overarm throw to a partner.
Quick Baseball
Hit, run to one hoop and back: everyone bats.
g46: Run the bases and stay safe on the mats.
Partner throwing and catching that gets harder as you succeed.
Kickball where several runners can be on base at once.

g13: Chuck the Chicken
A fun closer for the last class of the year.
Catch the Cone
Flip a small cone into a bigger one: hand-eye timing.
Jailbreakers
A fair hit frees a teammate from jail.
g46: Everyone can tag, so the whole class is moving from the first minute.
Throw tennis balls to knock volleyballs off cones.
Hit, run to the hoop, and fielders throw to the hoop.

g13: Back to Base
Travel, then hurry back to your base on the whistle.
Hoop underhand relay
Three underhand tries to land a beanbag in the hoop.
Shark Ball
Kick and run for the far line past the shark.
g46: The blob grows, so players must plan their escape routes.
Strike the ball between players for placement.
All four hitters run a base on any hit.

g13: Octopus
Cross the gym past the octopus; tagged players become helpers.
Throw-Clap-Catch
Clap first, then catch: eyes on the ball.
Barkball
Hit or kick, run to the far line and back.
g46: Short bursts of chasing for a quick, fair warm-up.
Four balls in play: fielders must decide fast.
Six-base kickball to finish the year.

bands.label: Grades 1–3
bands.blurb: Simpler rules, lots of moving, and one skill at a time.

bands.label: Grades 4–6
bands.blurb: More strategy, teamwork and game skills.
